components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The terracotta call to action. Most CTAs point at WhatsApp.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; background: #D4714E; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: 'Supermassive RS', sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.875rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-decoration: none; padding: 1rem 2rem; border: 2px solid #D4714E; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #E8956A; border-color: #E8956A; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(212, 113, 78, 0.3); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #B05433; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; background: transparent; color: #D4714E; font-family: 'Supermassive RS', sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.875rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-decoration: none; padding: 1rem 2rem; border: 2px solid #D4714E; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #D4714E; color: #FFFFFF; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #B05433; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-dock { display: inline-flex; align-items: stretch; height: 64px; padding: 0 8px; background: rgba(250, 247, 244, 0.9); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(1.4); backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(1.4); border: 1px solid rgba(26, 20, 18, 0.09); border-radius: 21px; box-shadow: 0 14px 36px rgba(26, 20, 18, 0.16); } .ds-dock__item { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 4px; padding: 0 16px; color: rgba(26, 20, 18, 0.52); text-decoration: none; } .ds-dock__item--current { color: #B05433; } .ds-dock__bar { position: absolute; top: -1px; left: 50%; width: 20px; height: 2px; border-radius: 0 0 2px 2px; background: #D4714E; transform: translateX(-50%) scaleX(0); transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-dock__item--current .ds-dock__bar { transform: translateX(-50%) scaleX(1); } .ds-dock__icon { width: 22px; height: 22px; } .ds-dock__item--current .ds-dock__icon { color: #D4714E; } .ds-dock__name { font-family: 'Switzer', sans-serif; font-size: 0.58rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.09em; text-transform: uppercase; }

narrative.overview: Kombu is the dependable base layer under a brand, the thing everything else rests on, so the design carries itself the same way: structural, unhurried, and confident without raising its voice. The warm off-white surface recedes; real client work sits on top and does the talking. Boldness is spent in exactly one place per page. The system deliberately escapes the warm-cream-plus-terracotta AI monoculture it superficially resembles, through a self-hosted display face, deep charcoal chapter sections, editorial numbered case studies, and choreographed rather than sprinkled motion. Voice is first person singular, plainly British: grounded, exacting, human.
keyCharacteristics: Warm off-white base that recedes so client work is the loudest thing on screen.
One saturated terracotta accent, used sparingly, as the single brand voice.
Deep charcoal sections used as structural chapter breaks, not decoration.
Big self-hosted display type against extralight body text: a deliberate weight contrast.
Quiet by default; boldness rationed to one signature moment per page.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Terracotta is the only saturated colour in the system and appears on a small share of any screen. Do not introduce a second accent hue; range comes from the charcoal/warm-white contrast and from typography.

rules.name: The Dark-Ink-On-Terracotta Rule
rules.body: White text fails WCAG AA on the terracotta surface (#D4714E). Body text on a terracotta fill uses dark ink (#1A1412); small terracotta text on light backgrounds uses Terracotta Deep (#B05433).

rules.name: The Weight-Contrast Rule
rules.body: Never pair Supermassive with another heavy sans, and never bring the body up to regular to match. The extralight-body against heavy-display contrast is the identity.

rules.name: The Heading-Stack Rule
rules.body: Every heading on every Kombu surface uses font-family: Supermassive RS, Supermassive FB, sans-serif with text-transform: uppercase. Supermassive RS is Ryan's licensed cut with custom-drawn punctuation, so it covers the full character set on its own and needs no fallback face. Never set a heading in a serif or in the body face.

rules.name: The Warm-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are built on the ink hue (rgba(26, 20, 18, ...)), never pure black. The only coloured shadow allowed is the terracotta accent glow on primary hover.

dos: Do keep terracotta (#D4714E) as the only saturated colour, on a small share of any screen (The One Voice Rule).
Do put dark ink (#1A1412) on terracotta fills and use Terracotta Deep (#B05433) for small terracotta text on light backgrounds; verify body text hits AA.
Do preserve the weight contrast: heavy Supermassive display against extralight (200) Switzer body.
Do use charcoal (#1A1412) sections as deliberate chapter breaks between light sections.
Do spend boldness on one signature moment per page and keep everything around it restrained.
Do honour prefers-reduced-motion with the static .no-motion path, and keep content visible by default so reveals enhance rather than gate it.
Do write first person singular, British English, with no em-dashes or en-dashes anywhere including aria-labels.
donts: Don't let this become vibe-coded AI slop: no tracked uppercase eyebrow above every section, no identical icon-heading-text card grids, no gradient text, no big-number hero-metric block.
Don't use side-stripe borders (a border-left/right greater than 1px as a coloured accent). Use full borders, background tints or leading numerals.
Don't drift toward a generic agency look: no we/our voice, no team grid, no wall of identical service cards, no buzzwords.
Don't drift toward corporate SaaS: no cold navy-and-gradient, no feature-grid gloss with no human behind it.
Don't drift toward a loud freelancer portfolio: motion serves the work and never upstages it; no neon, no over-animation.
Don't introduce a second accent hue, hard pure-black shadows, or bring the body weight up to regular.
Don't mention AI or the tooling behind the work anywhere on the site.
